# Terminal

Always-dark console frame with a header (title, status, actions) and a black mono body — the place to mount xterm.js for incus exec/console sessions.

`KenosUI.Terminal` · Typography

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Terminal>…</KenosUI.Terminal>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Terminal">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Always-dark console frame; the ref points at the body (mount xterm.js there).

## Props (TerminalProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `status` | `React.ReactNode` | e.g. <Status status="online">Verbunden</Status> |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `height` | `number \| string` | Body height. Default 20rem. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Mount xterm.js into the ref'd body, or pass text. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">._
